dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: See workspace priorities, recent activity and useful next steps based on your real data.
quickTips: Jump into clients, projects or Copilot
Use the morning brief when available
learn: Start work from a quick action

steps.title: Your workspace overview
steps.body: The Dashboard shows what is happening across Assistify using your real clients, projects and activity — never invented sample charts.

steps.title: Priorities and attention
steps.body: Scan priorities, recent work and checklist items so you know where to start today.

steps.title: Quick actions
steps.body: Jump into Copilot, search, or morning brief when you want a faster next step.

steps.title: Where to go next
steps.body: Use Help on any module, or open Clients, Projects and Copilot from the sidebar.

overview.title: This is your Dashboard
overview.body: Start here for a calm overview of workspace activity.

priorities.title: See what needs attention
priorities.body: Checklist items and brief lines point to real work — nothing is faked.

quick-actions.title: Use a quick action
quick-actions.body: Ask AI, open search, or continue a brief when you are ready.

next.title: Continue from here
next.body: Open Help anytime, or move to Clients, Projects and Copilot.

clients.title: Clients
clients.description: Store the people and companies you work with so projects, documents and AI stay connected.
quickTips: Add a client with clear contact details
Open a client to review linked work
Keep notes that help future follow-ups

crm.title: CRM
crm.description: Manage leads, clients and sales opportunities from one place.
quickTips: Move to Pipeline to add and follow leads
Keep notes so follow-ups stay clear

steps.title: Open CRM / Pipeline
steps.body: Pipeline is where sales leads live. CRM contacts keep relationship context next to those opportunities.

steps.title: Click New lead
steps.body: Start a lead when someone shows interest. You stay in control of every save.

steps.title: Enter example details
steps.body: Add a clear title and basic details so the opportunity is easy to recognize later.

steps.title: Save the lead
steps.body: Saving stores the lead in your workspace. Nothing is created until you choose Save.

steps.title: Change the status
steps.body: Move the lead through stages such as New, Contacted or Qualified as the conversation progresses.

steps.title: Add a note or follow-up
steps.body: Capture the next step so you do not rely on memory alone.

steps.title: See the lead on the board
steps.body: The lead appears in its stage column so you can follow up and keep momentum.

new-lead.title: Add a new lead here
new-lead.body: Click New lead to open the form. Assistify will not create anything until you save.

fill-form.title: Fill in the key details
fill-form.body: Give the lead a clear title and update fields that matter for follow-up.

save.title: Save the lead
save.body: Click Save when you are ready. This tour never saves for you.

follow-up.title: Follow up from here
follow-up.body: Great. From here you can change the stage, add notes and keep the opportunity moving.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.description: Track potential revenue from first opportunity to won deal.
quickTips: Open a lead to edit value, stage and notes

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Organize client delivery with deadlines, tasks and shared context.
quickTips: Create a project for active client work
Use the workspace for notes and documents

steps.title: Create a project
steps.body: Projects organize client delivery. You stay in control of every save.

steps.title: Name and details
steps.body: Give the project a clear title so it is easy to find later.

steps.title: Link a client
steps.body: Connect the project to a client when you have one — context stays together.

steps.title: Save when ready
steps.body: Nothing is created until you click Save. Then add tasks and use AI with project context.

create.title: Create a project here
create.body: Click New project to open the form. Assistify will not create anything until you save.

details.title: Add the project name
details.body: Enter a clear title for the work you are organizing.

client.title: Link a client when you can
client.body: Optional but useful — it keeps delivery connected to the relationship.

save.title: Save the project
save.body: Click Save when you are ready. This tour never saves for you.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Track what needs to be done, who owns it and when it is due.
quickTips: Close work when it is done

copilot.title: Copilot
copilot.description: Copilot is your AI assistant inside Assistify. It can use workspace context you provide to help plan, write and summarize — always review the output.
learn: Use client or project context when available

steps.title: Open Copilot
steps.body: Copilot is your AI assistant inside Assistify — not a generic empty chat. It can use workspace context where supported.

steps.title: Ask a business question
steps.body: Example (demo only): “Create a short project update for client Acme based on the latest project activity.” This example does not create Acme in your workspace.

steps.title: Use client or project context
steps.body: When clients and projects exist, Copilot can ground drafts in that information.

steps.title: Generate a draft
steps.body: Assistify prepares helpful text. You review before anything is sent or published.

steps.title: You stay in control
steps.body: AI can be wrong. Review the answer, edit it, and decide the next step yourself.

open.title: You are in Copilot
open.body: This is where you ask for summaries, drafts and plans grounded in Assistify.

ask.title: Type a clear question
ask.body: Ask about a client, project plan, follow-up email or what needs attention — you stay in control of sending.

send.title: Send when you are ready
send.body: The tour will not send for you. Review every answer before acting on it.

review.title: Review before you act
review.body: Assistify prepares. You decide what happens next.

agents.title: AI Agents
agents.description: Focused assistants for repeatable parts of your workflow. You stay responsible for final decisions.
quickTips: Open an agent for a specific job

proposals.title: Proposals
proposals.description: Create proposal drafts using client and project information already in your workspace.
quickTips: Export when the draft is ready

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Keep important business documents connected to the work they belong to.

automations.title: Automations
automations.description: Configure repeatable rules from currently supported triggers and actions. Automations stay reviewable and can be paused.
automations.betaNote: Automations are available in a limited beta form. Help only describes controls that exist today — do not expect every workflow pattern to run yet.
quickTips: Review existing rules before enabling more
Prefer approval modes for consequential actions
Check history after a rule runs

knowledge.title: Knowledge Brain
knowledge.description: Store business facts Assistify can use for better answers. You control what is remembered.
quickTips: Keep sensitive secrets out of free-form notes when possible

opportunities.title: Opportunities
opportunities.description: See suggested follow-ups and signals that may need attention. Treat suggestions as guidance, not automatic decisions.
quickTips: Act only on items that matter

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect supported tools so Assistify can work with mailboxes and other services you enable.
